[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
The item bags for Interdimensional Harvest

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
Extract the compressed package to the location where the item bag is installed. 
Keep the .json in "......\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\......\Item Bags\ItemBags\assets\Modded Bags"
将压缩包解压至item bag安装的文件夹，保证.json文件在item bag的 Modded Bags内。
